maya: Heads up — planning to pin marlin-5b-v2 into the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need smoke owners and a rollback plan. cc @alex @ryan
alex: I can own the canary smoke tests (10:05–10:20). Will run perf + token-stability set, and the regression prompts.
ryan: I can watch infra metrics, KV cache warmup, and autoscaler signals. Ping me when canary starts.
pm-olivia: product request — keep behavior identical to marlin-5b-v1 for the top-5 customer prompts, please. QA will validate.
qa-jun: I’ll run the regression set and hallucination checks. Can someone drop the pin config so I can pre-generate expected outputs?
deploy-bot: scheduler queued: marlin-5b-v2 -> catalog (slot=stable-3). ETA 2025-03-12 10:00 PT. Canary: 5% for 15m.
alex: Quick pin config (for QA/ops):
```json
{"model":"marlin-5b","version":"v2","pin_scope":"account","canary_percent":5,"canary_window_mins":15,"rollback_on_error":true}
```
maya: Rollback criteria proposal: if request_error_rate > 3% for 2 consecutive minutes OR median 99p latency regresses > 20% vs baseline => immediate rollback to marlin-5b-v1. Alex will trigger.
alex: I’ll prepare the rollback playbook and a hotfix branch for immediate re-pin. Infra team is on standby.
ryan: FYI load test from yesterday showed +8% tail latency at 1.2x current production QPS. That should be OK for a 5% canary, call out if we see tail spike.
maya: Locking the deploy window 10:00–10:30 PT. If canary looks good, schedule full rollout at 10:45 PT. :thumbsup:
pm-olivia: Noted, tagging analytics to watch drift hooks and content-score changes.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy started at ts=1753220400
alex: smoke tests green at 10:07 — perf within 1.5%, no hallucination regressions on the sample set. Scaling to 25% now.
maya: Awesome, please keep thread updates if anything strange. Thanks everyone for quick turn-around!
_meta: Generated Slack thread for model catalog pin / deployment coordination (marlin-5b-v2).
